instruction: I'd like to set up a global hotkey to pause and resume playback in VLC, so I can control it even when the window isn't focused. Please configure this for me.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling a global hotkey for play/pause in VLC. The evaluator uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric to verify the vlcrc config file has a non-empty global-key-play-pause setting (value 1 means configured, 0 means empty/not configured). User must navigate to VLC preferences and set a global hotkey.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: global hotkey for play/pause must be configured

Metric (check_global_key_play_pause) correctly checks if global-key-play-pause setting is non-empty (empty='0'/not configured, non-empty='1'/configured)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted to vlcrc file
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Semantic flow is correct: instruction → config file → check setting → verify configured
